subject: Region residency pathway & capacity amendment
messages:
From: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@lumahealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@medframe.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal + EU residency and APAC staging request

Hi Lauren —

As we approach our renewal (Dec 1), LumaHealth is planning an EU primary residency requirement for EU traffic and a staged APAC pilot for next quarter. Our compliance and infra teams asked for a clear path for:

- Data residency in EU (data at rest + logs)
- Warm standby in APAC for failover and burst capacity
- A short SLA addendum for failover times during cutover windows

We received the draft renewal you shared via the portal but need a capacity uplift (about 2.5x peak tokens for six months) and an explicit cross-region failover runbook for audits. Can you confirm if Redwood can: (1) reserve dedicated GPUs in eu-west-1, (2) provide private residency for EU logs, and (3) stage APAC capacity in a warm standby model?

I've attached our compliance checklist and a peak forecast. Happy to jump on a call this week.

Thanks,
Anita Sharma
Head of IT Operations
LumaHealth Technologies

Attachments: LumaHealth_compliance_checklist.pdf (pdf), LumaHealth_peak-forecast.xlsx (xlsx)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@lumahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency and APAC staging request

Hi Anita —

Thanks for the clear ask and the forecasting file. Short answer: yes, we can support this shape, but we need to align on three items before I can lock the SOW:

1) Residency depth: do you require "EU-only" for all persisted logs + metrics, or is pseudonymized metrics ok to leave in our control plane (hosted) for 90 days?
2) Capacity sizing: we can commit dedicated eu-west-1 capacity at a reserved rate, but the 2.5x peak for six months will require a short-term top-up rider in the renewal (pricing-addendum.docx).
3) Failover runbook: we have a cross-region failover matrix; I'll propose a canary failover window and RTO/RPO targets. That will be captured in a separate appendix to the SOW.

Proposed next steps:
- I will circulate a redline SOW and the pricing addendum by Friday.
- Ben: can you outline the dedicated pool sizing options (GPUs, target ingestions/sec) and the estimated monthly commit?
- Mateo: can you confirm the ops lead who will own the failover runbook and whether an on-call handover is required during the pilot?

Anita — do you have a preferred date/time for a 30-min technical alignment this week?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment referenced: LumaHealth_peak-forecast.xlsx (received)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency and APAC staging request

Lauren / team —

I've reviewed the forecast. Quick notes:

- For a 2.5x peak uplift we recommend two flavors: Reserved high-throughput pool (8x A800 equiv) for live production + a Warm Standby APAC pool (4x A800 equiv) in a burst-ready config. That maps to roughly a committed monthly spend of 1.9x current commit — full numbers in the pricing addendum draft.
- If LumaHealth requires logs + metrics retained only in EU, we should propose a Private Control Plane (Redwood Private) for EU that keeps all persisted telemetry inside their VPC. That will add onboarding lead time (~6 weeks) and a one-time deployment fee.
- Cross-region failover: proposed RTO 3h / RPO 15m for the pilot. We can shave RTO down with an active KV cache replication path but that has an engineering lead time and additional cost.

Mateo — can you volunteer to create the initial failover matrix and a short runbook draft? Olga — please start a SOC/Compliance evidence pack focusing on EU-log residency (we'll need it for their audit).

Ben
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@lumahealth.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2028 16:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency and APAC staging request — SOW and runbook uploaded

Hi Anita / team —

Following up: I uploaded the redline SOW (LumaHealth_SOW_v2.pdf), the pricing addendum (pricing-addendum.docx), and a first-draft cross-region failover matrix (cross-region-failover-matrix.xlsx) to the shared Drive link below. Highlights:

- SOW: includes reserved eu-west-1 pool sizing options and a 6-month top-up rider; included SLA appendix for failover windows.
- Pricing addendum: line-itemed commit vs burst pricing and the private control plane one-time deployment fee.
- Failover matrix: clear steps for detection, automatic route failover, KV-cache warm-up, and rollback. RTO/RPO assumptions and party responsibilities are called out.

Next steps for LumaHealth: please review and flag redlines by Nov 6 so we can include the rider in the Dec 1 renewal. If you'd prefer, we can schedule a technical walkthrough of the failover matrix on Nov 2 — 30 minutes.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1q2w3e_Luma-SOW

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
SRE Lead — Regional Deployments | Redwood Inference
